description_en: Calls the CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment operation to attach a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) instance to an Enterprise Edition transit router instance to enable private network peering. After the attachment is created, the transit router instance helps you implement private network connectivity through forwarding and routing
description_zh: 调用CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment接口将要互通的专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）实例连接至转发路由器实例。连接后，转发路由器实例可以帮助您实现私网互通

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN)
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router
parameters.help_zh: 企业版转发路由器实例ID
parameters.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the VPC instance is deployed.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
VPC实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the VPC attachment.

The name can be left empty or can contain 1 to 128 characters. It cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
VPC连接的名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the VPC attachment.

The description can be left empty or can contain 1 to 256 characters. It cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
VPC连接的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_description

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the VPC instance belongs. The default value is the ID of the current logon Alibaba Cloud account.

This parameter is required if you want to attach a network instance that belongs to a different account
parameters.help_zh:
VPC实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID。默认值为当前登录的阿里云账号ID。

如果您要加载跨账号的网络实例，本参数必填
parameters.name: vpc_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The billing method. Default value: POSTPAY, which indicates the pay-as-you-go billing method
parameters.help_zh: 付费方式。默认值：POSTPAY，表示按量付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request, including permission checks and instance status validation. Valid values:

false (default): sends a normal request and creates a VPC after the check passes. Use this value to create a VPC.
true: sends a dry run request for validation only without creating the VPC attachment. The check includes whether required parameters are specified and whether the request format is valid. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。取值：

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建VPC连接。
true：发送检查请求，只进行校验，不会创建VPC连接。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`
parameters.name: dry_run

fields.help_en:
The vSwitch instance in a zone supported by the Enterprise Edition transit router.

You can select vSwitch instances for up to 10 zones at a time
fields.help_zh:
在企业版转发路由器支持的可用区中选择一个交换机实例。

一次最多支持为10个可用区选择交换机实例
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of a zone supported by the Enterprise Edition transit router.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36064.html to query zone IDs.

You can select up to 10 zones at a time
fields.help_zh:
企业版转发路由器支持的可用区的ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36064.html接口查询可用区的ID。

一次最多支持选择10个可用区
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
Select a vSwitch instance in a zone supported by the Enterprise Edition transit router.

You can add up to 10 entries at a time
parameters.help_zh:
请在企业版转发路由器的可用区中选择一个交换机实例。

一次最多支持添加10组信息
parameters.name: zone_mappings

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the Enterprise Edition transit router automatically publishes route entries to the VPC instance.

false (default): does not automatically publish route entries.
true: automatically publishes route entries
parameters.help_zh:
是否使企业版转发路由器自动发布路由到VPC实例。

false（默认值）：否。
true：是
parameters.name: auto_publish_route_enabled

parameters.help_en: The list of feature attributes for the VPC attachment (to be deprecated — use the new Options parameter instead)
parameters.help_zh: VPC连接的功能属性列表（即将废弃，请使用新入参 Options）
parameters.name: transit_router_vpc_attachment_options

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

If this parameter is specified, it cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

If this parameter is specified, it cannot be empty. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://.

Each tag key corresponds to one tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag key-value pairs at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空。支持输入不超过 128 个字符的字符串，不能以 aliyun 或者 acs:开头，不能包含 http://或者 https:// 。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入 20 个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The list of tags.

You can specify up to 20 tags at a time
parameters.help_zh:
标签列表。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息
parameters.name: tag
